new.diskHint: 0 = diskless. 128 MB is enough for TinyCore and FreeDOS.
new.iso: Or attach your own ISO / image
new.isoHint: Any bootable image: Linux, DOS, Windows 9x, hobby OS. v86 is 32-bit only.
new.noPresetHint: Pick an ISO/IMG file below or create an empty disk.
new.needSource: A preset or an image file is required
set.title: Virtual machine settings
set.memoryHint: Memory applies after the VM is stopped and clears old checkpoints.
set.engineHeadless: Headless — text console, runs without a logged-in user
set.engineHint: Applies after restart. Headless runs in the service session and shows VGA text only; GUI guests need the web engine.
set.netRelay: Full TCP via relay — no inbound forwarding
set.netHint: Applies after restart. NAT: guest reaches HTTP(S) and host ports can be forwarded into it. Relay: any TCP outbound.
set.netRelayNote: In relay mode inbound port forwarding is unavailable: only the NAT stack of the fetch backend can connect into the guest.
set.ftHint: replica keeps a second paused process in sync with the latest checkpoint and promotes it after a crash. Web engine only; headless falls back to checkpoints.
set.fwdHint: Listens on 127.0.0.1. The guest needs its network up (DHCP) before ports answer.
set.fwdDup: This host port is already used by another rule
set.shareHint: Headless engine only. In the guest: mount -t 9p -o trans=virtio,version=9p2000.L host9p /mnt/share
set.egressHint: Applies to both relay and nat (the guest then goes through v86's fetch backend). One target per line: host, IP or CIDR, optionally :port. Matching uses resolved addresses, so a DNS name pointing at 127.0.0.1 does not slip through.
clone.title: Clone virtual machine
clone.label: Name for the new virtual machine
snap.title: Snapshots
snap.revertLabel: The VM will be restarted from the snapshot. The disk image is restored to the same moment.
del.title: Delete VM
del.label: The VM will be moved to the hv86 trash (not deleted permanently).
